name: Mischa Eisenstein
original_name: ミーシャ・エイゼンシュテイン
source:
A girl from Russia who transfers into [url=https://vndb.org/c20897]Yukiha[/url]'s class. She was his closest friend during his time in Russia, and the daughter of a distinguished family.

She is extremely outgoing, even towards those she just met. Because of this, she's beloved by both boys and girls as the class mascot.

[From [url=https://fragmentsnote-plus.ullucus.com/en/]Switch Site[/url]]
